images.caption: Plan showing the inboard profile for 'Bellona' (1760), 'Dragon' (1760), and 'Superb' (1760), 74-gun Third Rate, two-deckers, and with alterations for the Arrogant class (1758): 'Arrogant' (1761); 'Cornwall' (1761), 'Defence' (1763), 'Kent' (1762), 'Edgar' (1779), 'Goliath' (1781), 'Vanguard' (1787), 'Excellent' (1787), 'Saturn' (1786), 'Zealous' (1785), 'Elephant' (1786), 'Audacious' (1785), and 'Illustrious' (1789) all 74-gun Third Rate, two-deckers, and with further alterations for 'Monarch' (1765); 'Magnificent' (1766), both 74-gun Third Rate, two-deckers of the Monarch class (1760), although this plan implies they were originally to be of the Arrogant class.
images.alt: Plan showing the inboard profile for 'Bellona' (1760), 'Dragon' (1760), and 'Superb' (1760), 74-gun Third Rate, two-deckers, and with alterations for the Arrogant class (1758): 'Arrogant' (1761); 'Cornwall' (1761), 'Defence' (1763), 'Kent' (1762), 'Edgar' (1779), 'Goliath' (1781), 'Vanguard' (1787), 'Excellent' (1787), 'Saturn' (1786), 'Zealous' (1785), 'Elephant' (1786), 'Audacious' (1785), and 'Illustrious' (1789) all 74-gun Third Rate, two-deckers, and with further alterations for 'Monarch' (1765); 'Magnificent' (1766), both 74-gun Third Rate, two-deckers of the Monarch class (1760), although this plan implies they were originally to be of the Arrogant class.
